message: Hi, I'm a student with a distro making certification background. My overall academic average is 78.9% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in data engineering and developer. I want to become a Network Security Engineer. My family can afford at most about USD 1300 per year. I live in Pune. I'd strongly prefer to stay near home, though I might consider elsewhere in India.
explanation:
This program directly aligns with your goal of becoming a Network Security Engineer by focusing on 'cybersecurity' and has a low tuition fee ($1150) that fits within your budget. It is also located in Kolkata, which is a manageable distance from Pune.

This MTech Cyber Security program is highly relevant to your career goal and has an affordable tuition fee ($1250). While located in Bengaluru, it offers specialized knowledge that will help you transition into a security engineering role.

This MTech Cyber Security program is ideal because it covers both 'cybersecurity' and 'networking_cloud', which are key areas for a Network Security Engineer. Crucially, it is located in Mumbai, making it geographically close to Pune.

This MCA program provides strong foundational knowledge in 'software_engineering' and 'data_science_analytics', matching your interest in data engineering and developer roles. The tuition ($1350) is within budget, and it requires a CS background which you possess.

This MSc Big Data Analytics program addresses your interest in data engineering. The tuition ($1300) is within budget, and while located in Coimbatore, it provides specialized skills that are highly marketable for modern developer roles.
